01 / A DIFFERENT KIND OF DESTINATION

More than a service.
A better part of your day.

Routine car care shouldn’t put life on hold. At Serv60, the vision is simple: look after your car, and give you something better to do with the time.

Eligible express servicing and a complimentary wash, designed around a 60-minute visit. Coffee, a fresh cut or a private workspace. Your hour, your way.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Does every service take 60 minutes?+

The 60-minute target applies to eligible routine services and includes check-in, inspection, maintenance, quality checks, washing and handover. Eligibility depends on your vehicle and the work required. The model needs operational testing before launch.

What happens if my car needs more work?+

We explain the findings and agree the next step with you before additional work proceeds. Mechanical repairs have a separate scope, booking and completion time.

Can I plan a haircut or workspace around my service?+

That’s the vision: coordinate your vehicle booking with a barber appointment, a coffee pre-order or a private work cubicle, wherever availability allows.

When can I book?+

Serv60 is currently a concept in development. The first hub, opening date, service eligibility and booking details will be confirmed before appointments open. Join the waitlist to hear first, with early access to the app.
